title: fix: clean up staged Gemini credentials when publication fails
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes leftover Gemini credential files when publishing a staged OAuth update fails.

## User Impact

Failed Gemini CLI preparation preserves the previous credentials and removes the staged replacement from the persistent profile directory. Existing profile-directory aliases and private file modes continue to work.

## Why This Change Was Made

The private-file writer created a sibling temporary file but never removed it after a failed rename. Reuse the existing fs-safe atomic replacement export for credentials, settings, and isolated execution files. Resolve the existing parent directory first to preserve directory aliases and the existing-parent requirement. This removes four production lines while keeping rename-only publication.

The regression extends the existing atomic-staging coverage through backend preparation. Shared test fixtures move into one helper to keep the auth suite within its line cap.

## Evidence

- The new ordinary-directory and directory-alias cases both failed on the original writer because credential temporary files remained after an injected rename failure. They passed after the change, preserving the previous target and permitting a successful subsequent write; both cases took 19 ms in the final run.
- `pnpm test extensions/google/cli-backend-auth.test.ts extensions/google/cli-backend-isolated.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 47 passed; Vitest 33.14 s, wrapper 39.50 s, wall 40.17 s. The auth file also passed alone in 33.89 s wall before the shared-fixture extraction. Proof uses synthetic credentials and real filesystem operations through backend preparation; it does not contact Gemini.
- `pnpm build`: passed in 567.90 s wall, including all 157 public SDK subpaths.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base e760a2ba465fd0d7d563224b053026a73e2bacb4 -- extensions/google/cli-backend-auth.runtime.ts extensions/google/cli-backend-auth.test.ts extensions/google/cli-backend-auth.test-helpers.ts extensions/google/cli-backend-isolated.test.ts`: passed in 428.60 s wall, including both extension typechecks, lint, line-cap and ownership guards, dead-export scans, and zero runtime import cycles. `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent managed P2 review: no actionable findings. The only subsequent source edit clarifies a comment; executable and test bytes are unchanged.

An intermediate test invocation stopped before running cases because an overlapping build changed its compiler input snapshot. The build finished before the successful final serial test run. Hosted CI timing will be recorded when available.
